verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Bland is a voice-agent platform whose agents call tools, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client. The evidence only documents Bland's own MCP server, which lets coding agents control a Bland account (the server role). It also documents a custom HTTP API tool, which is an adjacent feature and not MCP-client support. Nothing shows users can plug external MCP servers into Bland agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
